d: The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.

Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.
For our business, for clients, and for you
Role Type: Fixed term basis (1 year)

Working individually and as part of a team to cover an assigned set of funds as a knowledgeable and professional point of contact for fund investors, fund managers and internal teams regarding fund documentation, investor registries and AML/KYC processing.

Possess good understanding and knowledge of AML/KYC laws and guidelines set out by appropriate MENA Regulators, CIMA and Apex AML Policies (If it’s an internal hire) and adhere to these established policies, procedure and controls
Knowledge of Bermuda and BVI AML/KYC laws will be an added advantage
Should have knowledge of the all the Transfer Agency functions including AML/KYC and investor onboarding, Share Registry Dealings, Metrosoft screening, Payments, FATCA/CRS filings etc.
Should coordinate with the appropriate operations and CRM teams involved in order to ensure tasks are completed

Possess a basic Understanding of Fund structures - share classes vs. series and understand the NAV per share so as to enable publishing the correct prices to various pricing vendors such as Bloomberg, Refinitiv, Morning Star etc.
Basic understanding of accounting related to subscriptions, redemptions, distributions and ensure investor communications are released in line with procedures and deadlines are met
Establish a good relationship with FA teams and establish the workflow/procedures to ensure the FA team is updated at all times in relation to any TA activity to be included in the NAV
Responsible for Fund audits in relation to any TA related PBC requirements
Have a good command on the English language and possess good written and communication skills. Understanding of Arabic (written and speaking) will be an added advantage.
Possess good email etiquettes as the candidate will be communicating with the investors and clients
Confident in communicating with investors and handle any situations that arise in line with Apex’s policies

Should be able to read and understand and provide comments on the TA related aspects in a Funds PPM including coordinating with the Corporate Secretary for any waivers, Board Resolutions required in relation to any TA activity.
Maintain knowledge of assigned funds, fund timelines, deal documentation and related processes.
Understand workflows and organize responsibilities and priorities to meet and manage deadlines with exceptional attention to detail and follow through.
Participate in special projects as assigned, including automation efforts, enhanced controls, system testing and client research.
q: Overall, 5-7 years of experience with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in Transfer Agency role

d: The Driver / Messenger is responsible for providing safe and efficient transportation services for company personnel, documents, materials, and goods. The role includes delivering and collecting official documents from government authorities, customers, suppliers, banks, and other organizations while ensuring compliance with company procedures and traffic regulations.
q: High School certificate or equivalent preferred
Minimum 2 years of driving experience in Bahrain
Good knowledge of Bahrain roads, business districts, and government offices
Experience dealing with government authorities and document processing is an advantage
Basic English communication skills; Arabic knowledge is an added advantage
Ability to maintain professionalism when interacting with customers, suppliers, and government officials
Good organizational skills and attention to detail
Clean driving record and strong safety awareness
r: li
Safely operate company vehicles for the transportation of personnel, documents, and materials
li
Deliver and collect official documents, parcels, and correspondence from customers, suppliers, banks, government offices, and other stakeholders
li
Handle transactions and submissions with government authorities, including LMRA, GOSI, municipalities, customs authorities, ministries, and other regulatory bodies as required
li
Ensure timely collection and delivery of documents, invoices, purchase orders, permits, and other company-related materials
li
Maintain accurate records of deliveries, collections, and trips performed
li
Conduct daily vehicle inspections and ensure the assigned vehicle is maintained in a clean and roadworthy condition
li
Monitor vehicle service schedules and notify the supervisor of maintenance requirements
li
Assist administrative departments with external errands and operational support activities
li
Ensure the confidentiality and security of company documents and information
li
Report accidents, vehicle defects, traffic violations, or operational issues to the supervisor immediately
li
Support office and operational departments with additional duties as assigned

d: Nord Anglia Education is looking to recruit an HR Officer to join Etqan Global Academy in Doha, Qatar.
We are looking for someone to support HR operations across the school, contributing to a structured, compliant, and efficient HR function that supports school leadership and staff wellbeing.
We seek an individual to join as an HR Officer where your focus will be:
Contributing to the day-to-day delivery of HR operations across the school
Maintaining accurate and compliant employee records (digital and physical)
Preparing contracts, amendments, renewals, and official correspondence
Contributing to onboarding and offboarding processes, and coordinating visa documentation where required
Coordinating end-to-end recruitment processes, including candidate documentation and offer paperwork
Preparing monthly payroll inputs in collaboration with Finance, and administering employee benefits
Providing day-to-day, low-level employee relations support to staff, escalating complex or sensitive matters to the HR Manager
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
4–6 years’ HR experience, ideally within education or a similarly regulated sector
Strong knowledge of local labour laws and employment practices (Qatar experience preferred)
Experience with payroll processes and HR data systems
Well organised, with strong attention to detail
Confident communicator, comfortable working with school leadership
Please see full job description here

Nord Anglia Education is the world’s leading international schools organisation. Our 80+ international schools are located in the Americas, Europe, China, Southeast Asia and the Middle East. Together, they educate more than 80,000 students from kindergarten through to the end of secondary education. We are driven by one unifying philosophy: we are ambitious for our students, our people and our family of schools.

Our exclusive collaborations with prestigious institutions such as UNICEF, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), IMG Academy and the world-leading performing arts school Juilliard mean we’re at the forefront of educational thinking, while creating life-changing experiences for students.

By joining Nord Anglia Education you will become part of a committed and innovative team. As a member of the world’s leading premium schools group you will be joining an active network of like-minded people across the world.
On-line applications need to be directly through the Nord Anglia Education careers page and should include a CV.

At Nord Anglia Education, we are an equal opportunities employer dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce. In our schools and offices around the world, we treat all colleagues fairly based on their skills and qualifications, without discrimination.
We value individuals from all backgrounds, including those with different abilities and neurodivergent conditions, as well as those who identify with various protected characteristics.
Nord Anglia Education is committed to ensuring the highest possible safeguarding standards in our schools and we expect every employee to share this commitment.

Responsible for delivering high quality, efficient, individualized and technically excellent pastry preparation in accordance with Company Policies, strictly upholding any Public Health standards and towards a goal of achieving total guest satisfaction.
Reporting to the Executive Chef, Executive Sous Chef and Pastry Chef.
Subordinates – Confectioner and Assistant Pastry Chefs.
q: Minimum of 4 years' experience in a similar position at an International 5-star establishment.
Must display the ability to pay close attention to detail and desire to take pride in one’s work.
Knowledge and experience of Public Health policies and procedures.
Ability to read, interpret and demonstrate culinary fundamentals.

Excellent fluent English (verbal and written). English is the working and safety language on board Silversea vessels. This also includes the ability to give and receive instructions in verbal and written forms and to effectively and efficiently engage with guests and crew members.
r: li
Supervise all pastry and bakery operations, ensuring the highest standards of product quality, consistency, presentation, and productivity for both guests and crew.
li
Manage the preparation and production of pastries, desserts, bakery items, and specialty products for breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, dinner, crew dining, and special events.
li
Assist the Pastry Chef with menu planning, recipe development, maintenance of recipe manuals, and adherence to the company menu cycle.
li
Coordinate and fulfill guest special requests, dietary requirements, allergies, intolerances, and ingredient restrictions while maintaining exceptional service standards.
li
Organize daily pastry operations, including staff scheduling, station assignments, menu briefings, and ensuring all setups are completed on schedule.
li
Monitor food preparation to ensure strict adherence to company recipes, production quantities, execution methods, taste standards, and presentation requirements.
li
Conduct regular quality control through food inspections, tasting, and mise en place monitoring to ensure consistency across all pastry outlets.
li
Prepare and oversee pastry displays, buffet showpieces, show plates, themed presentations, and support cooking demonstrations, guest chef programs, and pastry demonstrations.
li
Coordinate daily operations with Restaurant Managers, Maîtres d’, and other departments to ensure seamless service delivery.
li
Manage requisitions, inventory control, food forecasting, equipment inventories, and cost control measures while minimizing food waste and maximizing efficiency.
li
Ensure proper food storage, handling, transportation, temperature monitoring, and record keeping in accordance with company procedures and Public Health standards.
li
Lead and enforce sanitation, food safety, pest management, and Public Health compliance programs, ensuring readiness for all internal and external inspections.
li
Maintain pastry facilities and equipment through proper use, preventative maintenance, repair reporting, and follow-up of maintenance requests.
li
Train, mentor, supervise, and evaluate pastry team members, including onboarding new employees and conducting technical, service, sanitation, and Public Health training.
li
Communicate performance expectations, maintain accurate training records, and foster continuous professional development within the pastry team.
li
Promote a positive work environment through effective leadership, teamwork, confidentiality, professionalism, and collaboration with all departments onboard.
li
Monitor guest satisfaction, proactively resolve service issues, respond to complaints, and ensure personalized hospitality and memorable guest experiences.
li
Prepare operational reports, communicate significant issues and observations to the Pastry Chef and Executive Chef, and ensure timely follow-up on identified concerns.
li
Enforce compliance with Company policies, Standard Operating Procedures, Code of Conduct, uniform standards, and grooming requirements.
li
Perform any additional duties assigned by the Pastry Chef, Executive Chef, or management to support overall galley and vessel operations.
